skills.skill: Round a decimal number to the nearest whole number
Recognize equivalences between fractions and decimal tenths

misconceptions.pattern: Compares decimals as if the point were not there, judging by the digits alone (e.g. thinks 0.8 > 1.0 because 8 > 1, or 2.3 > 2.15-style confusions).
Drops the tenths instead of rounding (e.g. 2.7 to the nearest whole answered 2 rather than 3).
Reads the fraction's numerator as the decimal digit without scaling to tenths (e.g. thinks 1/4 = 0.4, or 1/2 = 0.2).

strategies.intent: Line the numbers up on their decimal point and compare place by place, biggest place first — the ones before the tenths.
Look at the tenths digit: 5 or more rounds the whole up, less than 5 keeps it; then drop the tenths.
Rewrite the fraction with denominator 10 (or picture it on a tenths grid), then read off the matching decimal — a decimal tenth is that many tenths.
